overall_quality.evidence: Garbage collection in Java is a process that automatically reclaims memory that is no longer in use by the application. It works by identifying objects that are no longer reachable from the application's root set and freeing the memory they occupy. This process is managed by the JVM, which periodically runs garbage collection cycles to clean up unused objects.
